name: lanes
description: On-demand lane sessions beside your main Claude Code session: a mid lane for tests and verification, a low lane for search, scripts and crawling. Status line, /lane, and tools the main model calls.

main_model.title: Main model
main_model.description: The model the main session is meant to run (used by bin/claude-main and to pick which sessions get the effort floor).

main_fallback.title: Main fallback model
main_fallback.description: Second choice for the main session when the main model is overloaded (bin/claude-main passes it as --fallback-model).

main_effort.title: Main effort floor
main_effort.description: The main session never runs below this effort.

mid_model.title: Mid lane model
mid_model.description: Tests, verification, reviews of main's changes.

mid_fallback.title: Mid lane fallback model
mid_fallback.description: Second choice for the mid lane; empty for none.

mid_effort.title: Mid lane effort
mid_effort.description: Fixed effort for the mid lane.

low_fallback.title: Low lane fallback model
low_fallback.description: Second choice for the low lane; empty for none.

low_effort.title: Low lane effort
low_effort.description: Fixed effort for the low lane.

launch.title: How lanes open
launch.description: window: a terminal window per lane (Windows, macOS). background: claude --bg, watch with claude attach <name>.

permission_mode.title: Lane permission mode
permission_mode.description: Passed to each lane as --permission-mode. No one answers a prompt in a background lane, so where auto mode isn't available, pick dontAsk with an allowlist, or manual with lanes in windows.

idle_minutes.title: Close an idle lane after (minutes)
idle_minutes.description: A lane with nothing to do closes itself after this long; 0 keeps it open.
